name: Swarmkeeper Style
descriptionText: Swarmkeeper Style focuses on Attaching to multiple creatures at once, using your Copies, manipulating the battlefield in unpredictable ways.

abilities.name: Swarmkeeper Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, create 2 Copies within Range. Whenever you Attach, your Copies can also Attach to a creature within range that has no character's Attached.

actions.name: Controll the Swarm
actions.rulesText:
Choose 1: Pull 3 to all characters to whom your Copies are Attached -or- Push 3 to all characters to whom your Copies are Attached.
8+: Choose both, while deciding to do either one of them for each character.

actions.name: Hazardous Plains
actions.rulesText:
Create a Trap, adjacent to every character to whom your Copies are Attached.
9+: Instead place Pit Traps
